notes.text: The minor must be approved by the director of undergraduate studies.

Students anticipating a minor may select one of the following emphases: history of philosophy; logic, science, and technology; moral, political, and legal issues; literature and the arts. The page does not list the courses for each emphasis.
Alternatively, a student may design a minor in Philosophy tailored to his or her own interests, subject to approval by the director of undergraduate studies.
